display_long_description:
# 🧽 The Ultimate VR Cleaning Experience
Some people find peace in meditation. You're about to find it in a filthy room and a pressure washer.

## 🧼 Clean Your Way
Pick your weapon:

* 💦 **Power Wash** – Point, squeeze, watch years of grime just vanish
[media]

* 🍃 **Leaf Blower** – Blast away the mess and enjoy the satisfying power of a gust of air
[media]

* 🤖 **Robot Vacuum** – Take control of a cleaning robot and guide it around to tackle the mess
[media]

* 🫧 **Soap & Scrub** – Foam it up, scrub it down, see your reflection in it
[media]

* 🗑️ **Garbage Collection** – Somebody's got to haul it out, and today that's you
[media]

## 🌍 Interactive Environments
Every room is a disaster waiting to happen, in the best way possible.

* Poke at, pick up, and move basically anything
* Dirt that reacts to what you're actually doing
* Real progress you can see as you work
* A rhythm that's honestly hard to put down

You'll look up and realize an hour's gone. It happens.

## 👥 Living World
You're not doing this alone. Sharky's hanging around, tossing you the occasional job and pulling pranks the second you let your guard down. He's chaotic, he's interactive, and he's absolutely going to mess with you while you work.
[media]

## ⏱️ Rush Mode & Leaderboards
Race against the clock in **Rush Mode**, beat your best times, and climb the leaderboards to prove you're among the best cleaners.



## 🌐 Play Your Way
Available in **English, German, and French**.

Grab your tools, get your hands dirty, and turn every mess into a masterpiece!
